title: Size of the Acceptance Formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s,C\in\mathbb N$ with $C\ge |Q|+6k+5$, where $Q$ is its state set. The length of the binary serialization of the acceptance formula is at most $13C^2(s+n+2)^3$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
n, s, and C are natural numbers
C is at least the number of states of M plus 6k+5
